.claude-plugin/marketplace.json.summary: Plugin marketplace configuration file for better-base-tools project. Defines the plugin name, owner (Thore Höltig), version 1.2.0, and references two sub-plugins: batch_file_tools and project-intel-tool. Metadata describes purpose as more efficient base tools to reduce turns, duplicate tool calls and token usage.

.gitignore.summary: Git ignore configuration file. Excludes common development and build artifacts: .claude/ directory, Claude_Temp_Files/, node_modules/, dist/, log files, DS_Store, coverage reports, and vitest cache directory.

LICENSE.summary: MIT License file for the better-base-tools project. Copyright 2026 Thore Höltig. Grants free use, modification and distribution of the software with standard MIT terms.

plugins/batch_file_tools/.claude-plugin/.summary: Plugin metadata for batch_file_tools MCP server v1.2.6. Defines plugin name, description (batch file I/O cutting tool calls/context by 50-60%), version, author, repository links, and MIT license. Entry point for plugin registration.

plugins/batch_file_tools/.mcp.json.summary: MCP server configuration for batch_file_tools. Registers the MCP server with command 'node' running the compiled index.js from plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/dist/. Minimal configuration pointing to the server entry point.

plugins/batch_file_tools/CHANGELOG.md.summary: Complete version history of batch_file_tools from v0.1.0 (2026-04-22) to v1.2.6 (2026-07-02) using semantic versioning and common-changelog format. Documents features (batch_read/batch_edit modes, path access control, output token budgeting, error handling), breaking changes (mode renames, tool removals), and bug fixes. Key additions: fileinfo mode, searchTerm regex support, path exclusion/inclusion lists, normalized output formatting, elicitation gates, and structured error reporting.

plugins/batch_file_tools/hooks/hooks.jso.summary: Hook configuration for batch_file_tools SessionStart event. Registers a single hook that executes node script session-start.js at plugin root. Enables automatic startup checks and guidance injection on session start.

plugins/batch_file_tools/hooks/session-s.summary: Node.js session-start hook validating MCP build availability. Checks CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, verifies dist/index.js exists, returns JSON with instructions directing users to batch_read/batch_edit over native tools. Single 52-line file.

plugins/batch_file_tools/LICENSE.summary: MIT License for batch_file_tools plugin. Copyright 2026 Thore Höltig. Standard MIT terms allowing free use, modification, and distribution with liability disclaimer.

plugins/batch_file_tools/README.md.summary: Comprehensive documentation for batch_file_tools plugin covering motivation (43-67% fewer I/O calls, 46% context reduction vs native tools), detailed session metrics across three projects showing read/edit bundling gains, tool reference (batch_read modes: compact/verbatim/fileinfo; batch_edit ops: replace/replace_all/insert_at_line/replace_range/write), configuration options (16 env vars/args for logging, formatting, access control, token budgets), path access control model (allow/deny lists with elicitation), and requirements (Node.js v22+, MCP SDK, zod).

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/package.summary: Dependency lock file for batch-tools-mcp-server (v1.2.5). Locks exact versions of 100+ packages including @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.29.0, zod 4.4.3, express, and esbuild. Ensures reproducible builds across environments. Contains platform-specific optional dependencies for esbuild (win32, linux, darwin).

npm package manifest for batch-tools-mcp-server v1.2.6. Defines executable entry point (bin: batch-tools-mcp-server), build/test scripts (tsc, node:test with custom reporter), TypeScript+tsx tooling, production dependencies (MCP SDK 1.29.0, zod 4.4.3), and Node.js >=22 engine requirement. Distributes compiled dist/ directory.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/src/ind.summary: MCP server entry point orchestrating batch_read and batch_edit tools. Manages server initialization, tool registration with descriptions/schemas, request handling with progress reporting, authorization via elicitPaths, configuration parsing from args/env vars, and root directory management.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/src/lib.summary: In-memory edit buffer management for file operations. Loads and tracks file state (existed, exists, lines, endings), lazily reads content on demand, and provides write operations with parent directory creation. Handles ENOENT gracefully for new files.

Core edit operation executor applying replace, replace_all, insert_at_line, replace_range, append, and overwrite to file buffers. Handles exact and fuzzy (whitespace-normalized) matching, generates helpful error hints with nearest anchors, tracks byte/line changes, and maintains file state integrity through in-place mutations.

Formatting layer converting ReadOutput and EditOutput into tool-consumable ToolContentResult blocks. Handles output modes (assistant/user audience), error display with anchors and match hints, content truncation with budget management, and concise summarization of read/edit operation outcomes.

Utility module for extracting file references from code and markdown content. Uses regex patterns to identify imports, requires, markdown links, and path literals. Filters out non-file URLs and package names, returning a deduplicated sorted array of relative/absolute file references.

File system access layer providing safe read/write with authorization guards. Implements path resolution (symlink, home directory expansion), permission checking against allowed directories, detailed error mapping (ENOENT, EISDIR, EACCES), and support for excluded/approved paths.

File system globbing module using Node fs/promises API. Expands glob patterns and directory paths into sorted lists of absolute, symlink-resolved file paths. Provides utilities to detect glob syntax and check if paths need expansion (directories or patterns).

Line-aware text processing module preserving exact byte boundaries and line endings. Provides split/join operations, CRLF vs LF detection, line ending conversion, and normalized string matching. Supports byte-exact round-tripping for mixed-ending files.

Edit hint generation using Levenshtein distance for fuzzy matching. Finds nearest-similar lines when exact anchors fail, builds unique context windows around errors, and provides helpful suggestions for re-reading or widening anchors in edit operations.

Content formatting for different read modes. Compact mode strips whitespace and collapses lines for non-indent-sensitive files; minifies JSON; preserves indentation for Python/YAML/Makefiles. Verbatim mode normalizes indent (tabs to spaces) while preserving byte exactness. Supports sliced reads with offset/limit.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/src/too.summary: Core orchestrator for multi-file, multi-operation edits. Manages file planning with glob expansion, authorization checks, two-phase execution (line-addressed ops descending, content ops in order), overlap detection, buffer loading/writing, and detailed error reporting with near-match hints.

Core batch read handler implementing request deduplication, glob expansion, file caching, regex-based search with context-block merging, fileinfo metadata extraction (size/lines/refs), and multiple read modes with formatting normalization and offset/count pagination.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/src/typ.summary: Central Zod schema definitions. ReadInput/Output/Request/Result with modes (compact/verbatim/fileinfo). EditInput/Output with ops (replace/replace_all/insert_at_line/replace_range/write). Error reasons, ToolContentResult formatting, validation for batch operations.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/a.summary: Security-focused test suite covering file access authorization. Tests read/edit rejection for unauthorized paths, empty allowedDirectories handling, nested directory access, excluded path blocking, approval overrides, and isAccessible predicate validation.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/e.summary: Tests stopOnError cascading logic at root/file/op levels and dryRun mode. Verifies op execution phase ordering, overlap detection, and partial/error status propagation. Core validation of edit control flow and error handling strategy.

Tests fuzzy whitespace fallback in replace operations. Validates matching of tab-indented vs 2-space and 4-space indented files with normalized anchors. Ensures Phase 4 compose workflow handles indent variation correctly.

Comprehensive edit operation tests covering write/replace/replace_all/insert_at_line/replace_range ops. Tests line-ending preservation (CRLF/LF), batch multi-file edits, phase execution ordering, overlap detection, and error scenarios with anchors.

Comprehensive test suite for formatReadContent and formatEditContent functions. Covers output formatting, truncation with budget constraints, error handling, search result formatting (inline vs context blocks), and mixed result consolidation.

Tests file reference extraction from code (imports/requires/dynamic) and markdown links. Validates filtering of npm packages and node builtins, path normalization, deduplication, and regex patterns for both ES and CommonJS modules.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/g.summary: Tests glob expansion for edit operations across multiple files. Validates pattern matching, directory recursion with **, deduplication across path separators/case, per-file error handling, and rejection of incompatible ops on glob targets.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/h.summary: Lightweight test assertion helper mimicking Jest/Chai syntax. Provides matcher interface with toBe/toEqual/toContain/toHaveLength/toMatch and negation support. Wraps Node assert/strict for compatibility with custom test runner.

Custom streaming test reporter for Node.js test runner producing compact, LLM-optimized output. Generates summary header with pass/fail counts, failing test names with file:line-col locations, inline source lines, and actual return values. Caches file reads for efficiency.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/l.summary: Tests line-aware text processing preserving exact line endings (CRLF/LF). Validates splitLines/joinLines byte-exactness for round-tripping mixed-ending files. Ensures line counting and normalization across different line ending formats.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/r.summary: Comprehensive tests for batch read handler. Covers modes (compact/verbatim/fileinfo), pagination, search with regex/context, glob/folder expansion, deduplication logic, symlink resolution, and error handling. Validates refs extraction and match_count annotation.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/s.summary: Test suite for fuzzy string matching and edit anchor generation. Validates Levenshtein distance algorithm for typo tolerance, findNearestLine() for locating similar lines in content, and buildNearestAnchor() for constructing unique context windows around errors. Covers edge cases: empty needles, file size limits, boundary conditions, duplicate patterns, CRLF preservation, and uniqueness validation for edit operations.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/t.summary: Test suite for content formatting across read modes. Validates formatForRead() function for compact mode (whitespace stripping, JSON minification, indent preservation by file type) and verbatim mode (byte-exact reading, indent normalization tabs-to-spaces). Includes offset/limit slicing, CRLF preservation, line counting, and file-type-aware behavior (Python, YAML, Makefile, JSON, TypeScript).

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tsconfi.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for batch_file_tools scripts. Targets ES2022 with strict type checking enabled, including exact optional properties and unknown catch variables. Output compiled to dist/ from src/. Generates source maps and declarations for full type safety.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/vitest..summary: Vitest test runner configuration for batch_file_tools scripts. Runs tests from tests/**/*.test.ts files in Node.js environment. Minimal setup providing baseline for TypeScript unit and integration test execution.

plugins/project-intel-tool/.claude-plugi.summary: Plugin manifest for project-intel-tool. Defines metadata (name, description, version 1.4.8), author info, repository reference, keywords (tokens, efficiency, context optimization), and declares no external dependencies.

plugins/project-intel-tool/.mcp.json.summary: MCP server configuration for project-intel-tool. Registers project-intel-tool as MCP server executed via Node.js, pointing to compiled dist/index.js script in plugin root. Enables integration with Claude harness for tool invocation.

plugins/project-intel-tool/CHANGELOG.md.summary: Semantic versioning changelog documenting 23 releases from v0.1.0 to v1.4.8 with detailed categorization of fixes, additions, and changes. Tracks major features like subagent batching, MCP sampling mode, semantic scoring improvements, C# import resolution, role-based filtering, and nested sub-project knowledge discovery. Version 1.4.8 (2026-07-02) focuses on reducing subagent instruction overhead; earlier versions cover structural data freshness, batch clustering optimizations, and knowledge base aggregation.

plugins/project-intel-tool/hooks/hooks.j.summary: Hook configuration for project-intel-tool SessionStart event. Registers Node.js command to execute sessionstart.js hook script, which validates tool installation and triggers knowledge base initialization on session startup.

plugins/project-intel-tool/hooks/session.summary: Node.js hook script for SessionStart event. Validates CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT environment variable and checks if sessionstart-knowledge-check.js is built. Spawns the knowledge check subprocess and relays stdio/exit code. Provides actionable error if build is missing.

plugins/project-intel-tool/LICENSE.summary: MIT License for project-intel-tool. Grants rights to use, modify, distribute under conditions of attribution and liability disclaimer. Copyright holder is Thore Höltig (2026).

plugins/project-intel-tool/README.md.summary: Comprehensive guide for project-intel-tool, an MCP server that maintains persistent structural and semantic file maps to provide models with overview context without reading files. Details token savings vs exploration agents, two-layer data model (structural always-current, semantic AI-analyzed), session start behavior, three MCP tools (query with semantic scoring, scan with cohesion-based batching, submit_analysis), two scan modes (subagent default, sampling optional), configuration via environment variables, and design rationale. Covers staleness signals, comparison to alternatives, best practices, and troubleshooting.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/index.summary: MCP server entry point orchestrating scan, query, and submit_analysis tools. Manages project roots via MCP capabilities, coordinates scanning with optional MCP sampling or subagent batch output, implements query aggregation across knowledge bases, and serializes concurrent analysis submissions. Handles logging, progress reporting, and graceful shutdown.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/lib/a.summary: Helper module that prepares sampling batches by combining scan results with existing summaries. Calls buildFileMap and buildSamplingBatches to produce AI analysis workload.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/lib/c.summary: Unit tests for configuration parsing module (parseConfigArg, parseConfigArgRecord). Validates environment variable and CLI argument priority (env > argv > default), various argv formats (--key=value, --key value, bare flags), JSON object parsing with fallback behavior for invalid/non-object inputs, and edge cases (empty env vars, prefix confusion).

Provides command-line and environment variable configuration parsing utilities. Exports parseConfigArg (priority: env > argv > default) and parseConfigArgRecord (JSON object parsing from env/argv). Used throughout the project for flexible runtime configuration.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/lib/f.summary: Comprehensive test suite for file parsing (parseFileRefs) and C# import resolution (resolveCSImports). Covers TypeScript/JavaScript static/dynamic imports, default/named/namespace specifiers, export extraction, external packages, C# using/type/member/const declarations, text/markdown references, ESM extension resolution, and cross-namespace import linking. 40+ test cases.

Core file analysis module parsing TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, and text files to extract imports, exports, and intra-project references. Handles static/dynamic imports, re-exports, namespace imports, ESM .js→.ts resolution, C# using directives, public/internal members, and markdown file links. Builds dependency graphs via buildFileMap and resolveCSImports.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/lib/l.summary: Test suite for file locking mechanism (acquireLock, releaseLock, acquireSubmitLock). Validates lock creation with PID/timestamp, stale lock detection (1-hour timeout), dead process takeover, corrupt file handling, concurrent acquisition, and polling with timeout. Uses temporary directories and process mocking.

File locking mechanism for coordinating concurrent analysis jobs. Implements acquireLock and acquireSubmitLock with process staleness detection (1-hour timeout). Prevents race conditions when multiple scanners write to summaries.json.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/lib/p.summary: Unit tests for discoverSubKnowledge using temporary directories. Verifies sub-knowledge boundary detection without descending into discovered dirs, relative path normalization, ignored directory handling, exclude path filtering, and empty discovery scenarios.

Orchestrates project file scanning with git-aware change detection. Detects new/modified/deleted files via git or filesystem mtime, discovers nested .knowledge directories, builds dependency metadata via file-map, and manages incremental summary updates with delta metrics. Handles include/exclude paths and sub-project boundaries.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/lib/q.summary: Integration tests for query() recursive sub-knowledge aggregation. Tests nested aggregation via stored refs, aggregation from overrides when no top-level exists, cycle prevention, scope filtering across knowledge levels, and correct path prefixing in results.

Test suite for search scoring and output formatting (calculateConfidence, generateQueryOutput, outputToFluentText). Validates scoring logic for path/summary/exports/imports/searchTags/role/technologies matches, staleness penalties, flat/grouped output modes, verbosity levels (full/structure/semantic), folder aggregation, deduplication, and fluent text rendering with HTML comments.

Implements full-text search and ranking across file summaries with recursive sub-knowledge aggregation. Calculates confidence scores based on path, summary, exports, imports, technologies, and role. Supports grouped/flat output formats with multiple verbosity levels and semantic weighting based on file change delta.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/lib/s.summary: Test suite for batching and context building (buildSamplingBatches). Validates file dependency ordering via topological sort, cohesion-based component clustering, circular dependency handling, context file inclusion from already-summarized deps, token budget enforcement across batches, and completeness (all files appear exactly once). 15+ test cases.

Batches files for AI analysis using token-budget-aware batching with topological and dependency sorting. Builds intra-scan dependency graphs, packs components into batches respecting token limits, and manages sampling via MCP protocol or subagent workflow. Integrates with file-map and generates prompts with context from previously analyzed files.

Test suite for summaries persistence (getOrCreateSummaries, writeSummaries, mergeSamplingResults, markFilesAsDeleted). Validates path normalization (./ and backslash prefixes), collision resolution (non-deleted over deleted, fresher timestamps), JSON round-tripping, sorted output for stable diffs, field preservation on updates, deleted flag lifecycle, and partial merges.

Manages persistence of file summaries to summaries.json. Provides getOrCreateSummaries (with path normalization), writeSummaries (minified JSON), mergeSamplingResults, and markFilesAsDeleted. Handles absolute/relative path conversions.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/packa.summary: Lockfile for project-intel-mcp-server v1.4.4. Pins exact versions of 80+ npm dependencies including @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.29.0, zod 4.4.3, and dev tools (typescript, esbuild, tsx). Specifies Node >=22 requirement. Ensures reproducible builds with integrity hashes.

Package manifest for project-intel-mcp-server v1.4.8. Defines build, test, and inspect scripts; requires Node.js >= v22. Production dependencies: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.29.0, zod 4.4.3. Dev dependencies include TypeScript, esbuild, and tsx for ES modules. Binary entry point is dist/index.js. Licensed MIT. Authored by Thore Höltig.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/sessi.summary: Session-start hook that checks for existing project knowledge and suggests scanning if missing. Outputs HookResponse JSON with status and recommendations. Reads ENV_INCLUDE_PATHS and ENV_EXCLUDE_PATHS for config.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/tests.summary: Vitest-compatible expect() wrapper around Node.js assert/strict for test assertions. Provides chainable matchers (toBe, toEqual, toContain, toHaveLength, toHaveProperty, toMatch, etc.) with not negation support. Handles ArrayContaining for partial array matching. Reduces test migration friction when switching from Vitest to Node.js test runner.

Custom Node test reporter that formats test output with counts (passed/skipped/failed) and detailed failure info. Parses test events, extracts source lines from stack traces, displays actual vs expected values. Used by test:watch and test scripts via --test-reporter flag.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/tscon.summary: TypeScript compiler config targeting ES2022, NodeNext modules. Strict mode enabled with noUnused* and no* checks. Includes lib/** and root ts files, excludes node_modules/dist. Generates source maps, declarations. Enables exact optional properties and unknown catch variables for type safety.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/types.summary: Zod-validated type definitions and constants for the project-intel system. Defines FileSummary, SummariesData, SamplingBatch, output formats, configuration schema, and MCP tool contracts. Central type contract for all modules with constants for directories, file names, format/role/verbosity enums, and token budgets.

README.md.summary: Project overview for better-base-tools, a collection of Claude Code plugins reducing token usage and context overhead. Introduces batch_file_tools (batching reads/edits to cut 58% tool calls, 46% context) and project-intel-tool (persistent knowledge base for oriented exploration at near-zero cost vs 577k subagent tokens). Describes how tools work together: query orients without reading, batch tools execute changes efficiently. Includes author note on motivation for token efficiency over token-burning theatrics, installation instructions via marketplace, and comparative metrics against native tool workflows.
